name: oc-family-pack
description: A calm family week in the Control UI: shared calendars, today's highlights, weather, briefs, and chat with your agents.

scripts.build: node -e "require('node:fs').rmSync('dist',{recursive:true,force:true})" && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && openclaw plugins build
scripts.check:dist: node -e "const fs=require('node:fs'),path=require('node:path'),os=require('node:os'),cp=require('node:child_process');const out=fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(),'ocfp-dist-'));try{cp.execFileSync('tsc',['-p','tsconfig.build.json','--outDir',out],{stdio:'inherit'});const js=(dir)=>fs.readdirSync(dir).filter((f)=>f.endsWith('.js'));const names=[...new Set([...js(out),...js('dist')])].sort();const stale=names.filter((f)=>!fs.existsSync(path.join(out,f))||!fs.existsSync(path.join('dist',f))||fs.readFileSync(path.join(out,f),'utf8')!==fs.readFileSync(path.join('dist',f),'utf8'));if(stale.length){console.error('dist/ is stale, run npm run build: '+stale.join(', '));process.exitCode=1}else{console.log('dist/ matches src/ ('+names.length+' files)')}}finally{fs.rmSync(out,{recursive:true,force:true})}"
scripts.check:sqlite: sh -c 'files=$(grep -l node:sqlite dist/*.js); printf "%s\n" "$files"; test "$files" = dist/store-worker.js'
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:scripts && npm test && npm run validate && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning scripts/isolated-openclaw.ts openclaw plugins build --check && npm run check:dist && npm run check:sqlite
